date_scope_check.qualification:
R2-SC-008-R1: The wider Rasuwagadhi and Kimathanka order remains scheduled, from Thursday midnight to Sunday midnight. The official 72-hour wording is preferred for this schedule; a local resident’s four-day description is retained as a differing account.

REC50-R33-R2SC008-P1: Republica retrospectively says Rasuwa had been closed for 72 hours for the previous day’s election, then reports reopening from Sunday midnight and actual trucks crossing in both directions on 27 November 2017. Together with the contemporaneous 24 November order, this supports an approximate 24 November operational onset and duration greater than 24 hours for Rasuwa freight. The onset is derived from reported duration, not an independently observed first enforcement clock. It is not a new phase beginning on the reopening date. No Kimathanka or all-passenger operational endpoint is inferred.
